# ShortestPathMultiplicity

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The number of distinct shortest paths between node pairs in a network, which can vary under local topology evolution rules. Quantifies redundancy and alternative routing in neuromorphic topologies, affecting fault tolerance and signal propagation dynamics.
